title: BPW-2026-0634
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0634
BOE + BCA
CD 8
CONTRACT AWARD – SIDEWALK REPAIR PROGRAM – PACKAGE NO. 79: CTIEP
Recommending the Board:
DECLARE Geronimo Concrete, Inc. (Geronimo), first low bidder, to be the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, and AWARD Geronimo a contract for the Sidewalk Repair Program - Package No. 79: CTIEP for $1,974,591.90; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the contract after approval as to form has been obtained from the City Attorney.
(W.O.: E1909517)
summary: Awards Geronimo Concrete a $1.97 million contract for sidewalk repairs under Package No. 79 (CTIEP), the lowest responsive, responsible bid.
